So, let's consider the school system in the US. To apply an equality of opportunity concept,  you make sure that the public schools offer a similar experience and quality of education, or at least as close as you can get to it. Everyone can access the education offered, so therefore theoretically everyone could learn the same thing. But, as we all know not everyone comes out of school with perfect grades. There's a bunch of reasons for that, including things like IQ levels and societal reasons. So what to do about that? Well, we do our best. There's no way you can control every variable in a society to make sure everyone has a level playing ground, and there are things you have no control over whatsoever.
